summary: AGI Inc, a Brazilian bank listed on the NYSE under AGBK, furnished a Form 6-K containing its third-quarter 2026 earnings release for the period ended September 30, 2026, rather than any transactional event. Disclosed metrics include active customers up 29% year-over-year to 8.3 million, fee revenue of R$244.1 million, gross credit origination of R$10.2 billion, a R$38.8 billion loan portfolio, and net income of R$276.0 million. The release also references a previously announced program to repurchase up to three million Class A shares over one year. No advisor, premium, or deal mechanics apply.
